metric_contract.error_wrms_own: max over output grid of per-time WRMS using each row's own rtol/atol vector
metric_contract.error_common: max over output grid of per-time WRMS using tolerance-independent common error scaling
metric_contract.warning: Both are sampled-grid metrics, not a continuous-time supremum. They are not interchangeable.

grid_clipped_baseline.report_contract: Grid-clipped continuity arms; take a step at every requested output grid time.
grid_clipped_baseline.observed_accepted_steps: 102 at each of the three tolerances on all four spatial problems. This is consistent with the declared clipped protocol and is not by itself evidence of a tolerance-response defect.

within_family_dense_to_banded_speedup_di.metric: dense median wall time / banded median wall time at same problem, arm family and rtol=1e-8
within_family_dense_to_banded_speedup_di.scope: Within-family dense-versus-banded linear algebra diagnostic only; not a cross-solver speedup claim.

allocation_measurement.scope: setup + integration + final grid-state storage + teardown; statistics formatting excluded
allocation_measurement.verdict: Whole-run allocation counts do not prove or disprove zero allocation inside the solver hot loop.
